en: The image depicts an ancient stone theater partially obscured by trees, with a large semicircular seating area and some classical stone architectural elements in the foreground. The background consists of wooded hills. The text on the bottom of the postcard appears in both Greek and French, identifying the location as the 'Theatre of Epidaurus.' The image has an old, sepia-toned appearance, suggesting it is from the early 20th century.
